context_diary: The account_lookup function supports filtering by account type and currency with return_fields specification for selective data retrieval. Results can be limited to prevent system overload, with total match counts provided for awareness of dataset scale. The system contains substantial agent populations (500+ USD agents observed) and returns structured JSON with username, ID, email, status, and currency fields. Currency availability varies by account type — zero TRY agents exist in current dataset, indicating either currency restriction for agent accounts or absence of Turkish market agents. Hierarchy traversal requires valid parent ID from account_lookup to function properly.
